ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between a dominant low-intensity central region and localized high-intensity white regions on the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region composed of low-intensity black pixels. High-intensity white mottling concentrated on the lateral regions of both lobes, with the densest high-intensity patches at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with high vertical pixel depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge boundary characterized by high-frequency, moderate-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire visible length of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outward sweep originating from the median notch and terminating in acute upward-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel formations localized specifically on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct light-colored linear disruption is visible on the ventral surface of the left lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear scar on the left lobe; extensive irregular notches along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant colonization of acorn barnacles concentrated on the distal apex of each lobe.
